# video-agent-skills

> video-agent-skills is a multi-agent team of Claude Code skills that turns a video topic into a DaVinci/CapCut-ready timeline — from research to publish.

A collection of 11 specialized Claude Code skills that form a coordinated video production pipeline. Ten skills cover the full production chain (analytics → research → script → storyboard → voice → visuals → editing → publish); one skill handles live/presentation scriptwriting as an independent branch. Designed for long-form knowledge video (6–15 min) with human review checkpoints at every critical stage.
